package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;

/** Production callback/drain methods with deterministic account, work, and archive ports. */
class MainActivity {
    enum SyncPage { HOME, SETTINGS, CONNECTION }
    enum DiagnosticAction { INSPECT }
    static class Text { String text() { return "checking"; } }
    static final Text CHECKING_SAVES_144 = new Text();
    static class SecureConnectionStore {
        static class Connection {
            String endpoint = "official", username = "user", password = "secret", profile = "default";
        }
    }
    static class SharedConnectionConfig {
        String endpoint, username, password, profile;
        SharedConnectionConfig(SecureConnectionStore.Connection source) {
            endpoint = source.endpoint; username = source.username; password = source.password; profile = source.profile;
        }
        String getEndpoint() { return endpoint; }
        String getUsername() { return username; }
        String getPassword() { return password; }
        String getProfile() { return profile; }
    }
    static class SyncRuntime {
        static SecureConnectionStore.Connection account;
        static String selection, namespace;
        static boolean unavailable;
        static SecureConnectionStore.Connection currentConnection() { return account; }
        static String currentSelectionToken(MainActivity host) throws Exception {
            if (unavailable) throw new Exception("selection unavailable");
            return selection;
        }
        static String currentNamespace(MainActivity host) throws Exception {
            if (unavailable) throw new Exception("namespace unavailable");
            return namespace;
        }
    }
    static class Installer { boolean active; boolean hasActiveRequest() { return active; } }
    static class Readiness { String statusDescription() { return "not ready"; } }
    static class Inspection { String getMessage() { return "fresh history"; } }
    static class StaleArchiveReadException extends Exception {}
    interface Task { boolean run() throws Exception; }
    interface Done { void accept(boolean result) throws Exception; }
    interface Change { void run(MainActivity host); }
    RenewalArchiveReadState renewalArchiveRead = new RenewalArchiveReadState();
    SecureConnectionStore.Connection connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection();
    Object sharedConnectionSession = new Object(), facade = new Object();
    Object history = new Object(), homeObservationOwner = new Object();
    Inspection inspection = new Inspection();
    Installer installer = new Installer();
    Readiness readinessState = new Readiness();
    boolean resumed = true, destroyed, sharedAppreciationOnly, busy, cloudVerified = true, available = true, ready = true;
    Object detachedHomeRead;
    SyncPage page = SyncPage.HOME;
    String notice = "", details = "";
    int workCalls, reads, preparingReads;
    Task pendingTask;
    Done pendingDone;
    Exception failure;
    MainActivity() {
        SyncRuntime.account = connection; SyncRuntime.selection = "game-a"; SyncRuntime.namespace = "space-a";
        SyncRuntime.unavailable = false;
    }
    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    boolean isOfficialAccount(SecureConnectionStore.Connection account) { return account != null && "official".equals(account.endpoint); }
    boolean homeAccountAccessAvailable() { return available; }
    boolean readyForSaves() { return ready; }
    String comparisonCopy() { return "comparison ready"; }
    String safeText(String value) { return value; }
    void work(DiagnosticAction action, String label, Task task, Done done) {
        check(action == DiagnosticAction.INSPECT, "renewal must only request inspection");
        workCalls++; pendingTask = task; pendingDone = done;
    }
    void readComparison(boolean prepareNamespace) {
        check(facade == null, "renewal must create a fresh facade");
        check(history == null && inspection == null && !cloudVerified && homeObservationOwner == null, "clear old observation before read");
        reads++; if (prepareNamespace) preparingReads++;
        facade = new Object(); history = new Object(); inspection = new Inspection();
        homeObservationOwner = new Object(); cloudVerified = true;
    }
    void runPending() throws Exception {
        Task task = pendingTask; Done done = pendingDone; pendingTask = null; pendingDone = null;
        if (task == null) return;
        try { done.accept(task.run()); } catch (StaleArchiveReadException stale) { failure = stale; }
    }
    SharedConnectionConfig source() { return new SharedConnectionConfig(connection); }
    void open(boolean homeAvailable) {
        renewalArchiveRead.open(connection, SyncRuntime.selection, SyncRuntime.namespace, homeAvailable);
    }
    void freshActive() { onAccountRefreshStarted(source()); onAccountAccessChanged(source(), true); }
    // Scheduling port only; the real detached scheduler is exercised by test_detached_home_queue_execution.
    boolean startDetachedHomeRead(final SecureConnectionStore.Connection account, boolean prepare, boolean readiness, Object automatic) {
        final String selection=SyncRuntime.selection, namespace=SyncRuntime.namespace;
        this.cloudVerified=false;this.inspection=null;this.history=null;this.homeObservationOwner=null;this.facade=null;
        final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<Exception> readFailure=new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<>();
        work(DiagnosticAction.INSPECT,CHECKING_SAVES_144.text(),()->{
            if(!isCurrentHomeRead(account,selection,namespace))throw new StaleArchiveReadException();
            if(!readyForSaves())return false;
            try{readComparison(prepare);return true;}catch(Exception failure){readFailure.set(failure);return false;}
        },value->{
            if(!isCurrentHomeRead(account,selection,namespace))return;
            if(readFailure.get() instanceof StaleArchiveReadException)return;
            if(readFailure.get()!=null)throw readFailure.get();
            if(!value){this.notice=this.readinessState.statusDescription();return;}
            this.notice=comparisonCopy();this.details=this.inspection==null?"":safeText(this.inspection.getMessage());
        });
        return true;
    }
    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */
    static void check(boolean value, String message) { if (!value) throw new AssertionError(message); }
    static void noRead(MainActivity host, String message) { check(host.reads == 0 && host.workCalls == 0, message); }

    static void settingsTransitAndOneShot() throws Exception {
        MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS; host.sharedAppreciationOnly = true;
        host.open(false); host.freshActive(); noRead(host, "refresh callback must not read while account page is open");
        host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "account overlay cannot read");
        host.sharedAppreciationOnly = false; host.sharedConnectionSession = null;
        host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "return through settings cannot read");
        host.page = SyncPage.HOME; host.drainRenewalArchiveRead();
        check(host.workCalls == 1 && host.reads == 0, "HOME enqueues one worker");
        host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); check(host.workCalls == 1, "pending worker must not be duplicated");
        host.runPending();
        check(host.reads == 1 && host.preparingReads == 0 && host.cloudVerified, "HOME performs one read-only recovery");
        check("comparison ready".equals(host.notice) && "fresh history".equals(host.details), "existing comparison feedback is used");
        host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); check(host.workCalls == 1, "consumed recovery cannot repeat");
    }

    static void unavailablePendingFailureAndDedupe() throws Exception {
        MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.open(false);
        host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "unknown account is not success");
        host.freshActive(); host.onAccountRefreshStarted(host.source());
        host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "pending refresh invalidates queued success");
        host.onAccountAccessChanged(host.source(), false);
        host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "expired or failed refresh suppresses stale success");
        host.freshActive(); host.freshActive(); host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); host.runPending();
        check(host.reads == 1, "repeated fresh refreshes coalesce");
        host.freshActive(); host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); check(host.reads == 1 && host.workCalls == 1, "active result after consume does not reread");
        MainActivity active = new MainActivity(); active.open(true); active.freshActive(); active.drainRenewalArchiveRead();
        noRead(active, "active HOME without recovery need must not read");
    }

    static void foregroundBusyAndReadinessGates() throws Exception {
        for (int condition = 0; condition < 4; condition++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.open(false); host.freshActive();
            if (condition == 0) host.resumed = false;
            if (condition == 1) host.busy = true;
            if (condition == 2) host.installer.active = true;
            if (condition == 3) host.sharedAppreciationOnly = true;
            host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "unavailable foreground gate " + condition);
            host.resumed = true; host.busy = false; host.installer.active = false; host.sharedAppreciationOnly = false;
            host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); host.runPending();
            check(host.reads == 1, "gate preserves recovery until HOME is ready " + condition);
        }
        MainActivity expired = new MainActivity(); expired.open(false); expired.freshActive(); expired.available = false;
        expired.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(expired, "trusted current access must still authorize reading");
        MainActivity unready = new MainActivity(); unready.open(false); unready.freshActive(); unready.ready = false;
        unready.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); unready.runPending();
        check(unready.reads == 0 && "not ready".equals(unready.notice), "readiness failure uses existing feedback without archive read");
    }

    static void rejectUnrelatedCallbacks() throws Exception {
        for (int dimension = 0; dimension < 4; dimension++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.open(false);
            SharedConnectionConfig source = host.source();
            if (dimension == 0) source.endpoint = "other";
            if (dimension == 1) source.username = "other";
            if (dimension == 2) source.password = "other";
            if (dimension == 3) source.profile = "other";
            host.onAccountRefreshStarted(source); host.onAccountAccessChanged(source, true);
            host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "foreign account callback dimension " + dimension);
        }
        for (int condition = 0; condition < 4; condition++) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.open(false); SharedConnectionConfig source = host.source();
            if (condition == 0) host.sharedConnectionSession = null;
            if (condition == 1) host.destroyed = true;
            if (condition == 2) host.connection.endpoint = "custom";
            if (condition == 3) SyncRuntime.unavailable = true;
            host.onAccountAccessChanged(source, true); host.drainRenewalArchiveRead();
            noRead(host, "closed or unverifiable callback " + condition);
        }
    }

    static void rejectChangedScopeBeforeAndDuringWork() throws Exception {
        Change[] scopeChanges = {
            host -> host.connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection(),
            host -> SyncRuntime.selection = "game-b",
            host -> SyncRuntime.namespace = "space-b"
        };
        for (Change change : scopeChanges) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.open(false); host.freshActive(); change.run(host);
            host.drainRenewalArchiveRead(); noRead(host, "old scope cannot queue a read");
        }
        Change[] workerChanges = {
            host -> host.connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection(),
            host -> SyncRuntime.account = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection(),
            host -> SyncRuntime.selection = "game-b",
            host -> SyncRuntime.namespace = "space-b",
            host -> host.page = SyncPage.SETTINGS,
            host -> host.resumed = false,
            host -> host.destroyed = true,
            host -> host.sharedAppreciationOnly = true
        };
        for (Change change : workerChanges) {
            MainActivity host = new MainActivity(); host.open(false); host.freshActive(); host.drainRenewalArchiveRead();
            change.run(host); host.runPending();
            check(host.reads == 0 && host.failure instanceof StaleArchiveReadException, "stale worker cannot inspect");
        }
        MainActivity canceled = new MainActivity(); canceled.open(false); canceled.freshActive(); canceled.renewalArchiveRead.clear();
        canceled.onAccountAccessChanged(canceled.source(), true); canceled.drainRenewalArchiveRead();
        noRead(canceled, "late callback cannot revive canceled queue");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        settingsTransitAndOneShot();
        unavailablePendingFailureAndDedupe();
        foregroundBusyAndReadinessGates();
        rejectUnrelatedCallbacks();
        rejectChangedScopeBeforeAndDuringWork();
        System.out.println("Renewal archive read host execution passed");
    }
}
